最终生成 Prompt
English:

text.content:
Minimal geometric logo mark made ONLY from straight lines and one circle.
The letter H and the letter T are merged together sharing structural lines
to form a shape that resembles an open doorway. H provides two vertical
strokes and a horizontal crossbar. T shares H's horizontal bar as its top,
with T's vertical stem going downward through the center — this center line
reads as light or a path through the door. A single small solid amber circle
(#FFB300) sits on the right vertical stroke as a door handle. ALL lines are
straight — no triangles, no arrows, no diagonal lines, no curves except the
one amber circle. Color: cyan #13C2C2 lines on deep navy-black #0F1923.
Below: "黑粉科技" in white #E8E8E8 and "HYPHENTECH" in cyan #13C2C2.
Flat vector, no gradients, no shadows.

中文：

text.content:
极简几何 Logo，仅使用直线和一个圆形。字母 H 和 T 共享结构线条，合并成一扇
打开的"门"的形状。H 提供两根竖线和一根横线（门框），T 的竖线从中间向下延伸
穿过门框——看起来像从门内透出的光线。一个实心琥珀色小圆点（#FFB300）位于右
侧竖线上，作为门把手。所有线条必须是直线——不要三角形、箭头、对角线、曲线
（门把手圆点除外）。颜色：青色 #13C2C2 线条，深藏青黑 #0F1923 背景。下方
文字："黑粉科技"白色 #E8E8E8，"HYPHENTECH"青色 #13C2C2。扁平矢量风格，
无渐变，无阴影。

6 种提示词策略

text.content: 策略 1：从零探索型 — 完全没想法时用

适合

text.content: ：刚起步、没有任何视觉想法的新人。让 AI 先出多个方向，你再从中选。

rich_text.plain_text: ：刚起步、没有任何视觉想法的新人。让 AI 先出多个方向，你再从中选。
English:

text.content:
I have NO visual idea for my logo. Help me explore.

Brand context:
- Channel name: 黑粉科技 (HyphenTech)
- Content: AI tutorials and tool reviews for non-technical people
- Personality: professional but approachable, like a smart friend explaining things
- Colors: dark theme, cyan (#13C2C2) + amber (#FFB300)
- Audience: Chinese-speaking, age 20-40, curious about AI but intimidated by tech jargon

Generate 4 COMPLETELY different logo directions in a 2×2 grid:
- Top-left: Abstract geometric mark (no text)
- Top-right: Lettermark using "H" or "黑"
- Bottom-left: Mascot or character-based (simple, not childish)
- Bottom-right: Pure typographic (text only, stylized)

Each should feel like it belongs to a different design agency.
Maximum contrast between the four. Dark background for all.

中文：

text.content:
我完全没有 Logo 的视觉想法，请帮我探索方向。

品牌信息：
- 频道名：黑粉科技（英文 HyphenTech）
- 内容：面向非技术人群的 AI 教程和工具测评
- 气质：专业但亲切，像一个聪明的朋友在解释事情
- 配色：暗色系，青色（#13C2C2）+ 琥珀色（#FFB300）
- 受众：中文用户，20-40岁，对 AI 好奇但被技术术语吓到

请生成 4 个完全不同的 Logo 方向，以 2×2 网格排列：
- 左上：抽象几何图标（无文字）
- 右上：字母标志，用 "H" 或 "黑" 字
- 左下：吉祥物/角色类（简洁，不幼稚）
- 右下：纯文字排版设计（仅文字，有设计感）

四个方向的风格差异要尽可能大，像出自四家不同设计公司。全部使用深色背景。

text.content:
Logo design with exact specifications:

Shape: The letter "H" constructed from two vertical bars connected
by a horizontal bar. The horizontal bar is a glowing pulse/waveform
line (like an audio or heartbeat signal) instead of a straight line.

Typography: "HYPHENTECH" below the mark in IBM Plex Sans or similar
monospace-inspired sans-serif, letter-spacing: 0.15em. Below that,
"黑粉科技" in Noto Sans SC Medium, 50% the size of the English text.

Colors (strict):
- Mark: cyan (#13C2C2) for the pulse line, white (#E8E8E8) for the
  two vertical bars
- Text: white (#E8E8E8) for "HYPHENTECH", muted gray (#9CA3AF) for
  "黑粉科技"
- Background: #0F1923

Exclusions: NO gradients, NO shadows, NO 3D effects, NO rounded
corners on the H bars. Flat vector only.

Show the logo centered on a 1:1 square canvas.

text.content:
Logo 设计，精确规格如下：

形状：字母 "H" 由两根竖条构成，中间的横条不是直线，而是一条发光的脉搏/
波形线（类似心电图或音频波形信号）。

字体排列：图标下方 "HYPHENTECH"，使用 IBM Plex Sans 或类似等宽感无衬线体，
字间距 0.15em。再下方 "黑粉科技"，使用思源黑体 Medium，大小为英文的 50%。

颜色（严格执行）：
- 图标：青色（#13C2C2）用于波形线，白色（#E8E8E8）用于两根竖条
- 文字：白色（#E8E8E8）"HYPHENTECH"，灰色（#9CA3AF）"黑粉科技"
- 背景：#0F1923

排除项：禁止渐变、禁止阴影、禁止3D效果、竖条不要圆角。纯扁平矢量。

Logo 居中展示在 1:1 正方形画布上。

text.content:
Design a logo for a tech education YouTube channel called "黑粉科技"
(HyphenTech).

Do NOT literally illustrate the keywords below — instead, use them
as emotional and conceptual fuel:

1. Decode — making complex things simple
2. Midnight — dark, focused, late-night coding energy
3. Bridge — connecting tech experts and beginners
4. Pulse — alive, rhythmic, always updating
5. Craft — careful, deliberate, not mass-produced

Requirements:
- Icon/mark only, NO text in the logo
- Abstract geometric shape preferred
- Color palette: cyan (#13C2C2) as primary, amber (#FFB300) as
  subtle accent, on dark background (#0F1923)
- Must work at 64px and 512px
- Clean vector style, no photorealistic rendering
- Output as a centered logo on dark background

text.content:
为科技教育 YouTube 频道"黑粉科技"（HyphenTech）设计一个 Logo。

不要直接图解下面的关键词——把它们当作情感和概念上的燃料：

1. 解码（Decode）——把复杂的东西变简单
2. 午夜（Midnight）——暗色、专注、深夜写代码的能量
3. 桥梁（Bridge）——连接技术专家和初学者
4. 脉搏（Pulse）——有活力、有节奏、持续更新
5. 手艺（Craft）——用心、精致、不是流水线产品

要求：
- 仅图标，Logo 中不包含任何文字
- 偏好抽象几何形状
- 配色：青色（#13C2C2）为主，琥珀色（#FFB300）为微量点缀，
  深色背景（#0F1923）
- 必须在 64px 和 512px 两种尺寸下都清晰
- 干净的矢量风格，不要写实渲染
- 深色背景上居中展示

size contrast only.

cyan (#13C2C2) and hot pink (#FF0066) neon.

elegant brush-inspired but modern typeface.

All 4 must include the text "黑粉科技". Each should feel like it comes
from a completely different designer.

the logo itself, no additional icon or symbol.

Character treatments:

  grid pattern, as if the character is built from binary data
- "粉" (meaning "powder/fan"): transform the "米" radical into a circuit
  node with 4 traces extending outward from the center
- "科技" (meaning "technology"): clean geometric sans-serif, 60% the size
  of the first two characters, positioned as a subtitle below

Color rules:
- All text white on dark background (#0F1923)
- ONE single accent: a glowing cyan (#13C2C2) dot at the center node of "粉"
- No other colors, no gradients

Layout: show both a horizontal lockup (single line) and a stacked version
(黑粉 on top, 科技 below).

Style: flat vector, no shadows, no 3D effects. Think Swiss typography meets
Chinese calligraphy structure.

relatedPosts.title: 我用Claude Code一个下午搭了个AI新闻收集器，GitHub Pages免费部署

text.content: 信息焦虑的本质不是新闻太少，是整理太难。本文记录如何用 Claude Code 在一个下午搭建 AI 新闻雷达：自动抓取 287 篇文章、AI 摘要分类翻译、GitHub Pages 零成本部署，全程几乎不写一行代码。
